## How to review

Read each row. For each translation, check that it says the same thing as the English, in words a speaker of this language would use. Mark anything stiff, wrong or unnatural. The English column is the source of truth.
To record a review, fill `reviewedBy` and `reviewedOn` in `_meta` of `src/i18n/locales/my.json` and set `source` to `human-reviewed`. The AI label then disappears for this language.

## Lines marked ⚠ (meaning differs a little)

- `aiNotice.text`: "authoritative" is rendered as "official": close, slightly weaker.
- `voice.consent.text`: "voice recording system" for "voice recognition" (အသံမှတ်သားစနစ်): recording and recognition are not the same thing. Needs a Burmese reader.
- `coach.notice.text`: "fictional" is "imaginary" (စိတ်ကူးယဉ်). Needs a Burmese reader.
